rows.name: RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PATH
rows.read_by: `rinzler`, `runtron`, the packaged systemd unit `rinzler@.service`, `bin/fuse_cleanup.py` (`src/system/fuse_helpers.cpp`, `packaging/systemd/rinzler@.service`, `bin/fuse_cleanup.py` and 7 more files)
rows.values: Directory path, used as given. An empty value counts as unset. The program creates a missing directory. A failed creation only logs the warning `Could not create FUSE mount point`.
rows.default: Unset: `/opt/positron/stats`. A program whose file path contains `/gen/` uses `<repository root>/stats`, and `REPO_ROOT_OVERRIDE` replaces the repository root.
rows.effect: Sets the base directory where the program mounts the FUSE stats. When the instance count is above 1, the program appends `/instance-<id>` to the path. `RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PRESCOPED=1` turns this suffix off.
rows.notes: `--fuse-mount` overrides it and is used as given. `rinzler_proxy` never mounts and ignores it. The packaged systemd unit sets `/var/run/rinzler/<N>`. It rejects a relative path, `/`, and a path directly under `/`. Logs: `FUSE mount point from RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PATH: <path>`, then `Stats/config mounted at <path>`.

rows.name: RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PRESCOPED
rows.read_by: `rinzler`, `runtron` (`src/system/fuse_helpers.cpp`). `rinzler_proxy` never mounts and does not read it.
rows.values: Only the exact text `1` has an effect. Every other text is ignored without a message, for example `true`, `yes`, `0` or an empty value.
rows.default: Unset: when the instance count is above 1, the program appends `/instance-<id>` to the FUSE stats mount path.
rows.effect: With `1`, the program mounts the FUSE stats at the base path and adds no `/instance-<id>` suffix. The base path comes from `RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PATH` or from the built-in default.
rows.notes: No effect with `--fuse-mount`, with an instance count of 1, or with no instance set. The packaged systemd unit sets `1`. A value in `/etc/rinzler/instance-<N>.env` replaces it. With the suffix on, the log holds `FUSE mount point scoped for instance`.

rows.name: RZ_KV_CACHE_GB
rows.read_by: `rinzler`, and `rinzler_host`, the rinzler build that runs models on the CPU (`src/rinzler.cpp`). `rinzler_proxy` parses the value and does not use it. `runtron` does not read it.
rows.values: Whole number of GiB, parsed with `std::stoull`. Text after the leading digits is ignored. Text that does not start with a number aborts rinzler at startup.
rows.default: Unset: with the arena allocator off, the target is half the hugepage count in GiB (8 GiB for 16 hugepages). Empty: rinzler aborts at startup.
rows.effect: Sets the target size of the KV cache, for all models together. The value applies only when the arena allocator (`pos_heap_v2`) is off. The build default is on, and `TRON_USE_ARENA_ALLOCATOR` selects it at run time. With it on, rinzler ignores the value and logs a warning.
rows.notes: `--kv-cache-gb` is parsed later and replaces the value. In `rinzler_host` the arena allocator is never on, and the value applies. Logs: `RZ_KV_CACHE_GB set to <text>`, `Trying to use <N> GB for persistent KV cache`, and when ignored `ignoring static KV cache sizing knob RZ_KV_CACHE_GB`.

rows.name: RZ_RUNFILE_DIR
rows.read_by: `rinzler`, `rinzler_proxy` (`h/rinzler/rinzler-config.hpp`, `src/rinzler.cpp`). The test launcher `t/proxy/rzproxy/launch.py` reads it too.
rows.values: Path of an existing directory that rinzler can write. The text is used as given. An empty value counts as unset. rinzler does not create the directory.
rows.effect: Sets the directory of the run file `rinzler-<pid>.run`. rinzler writes this JSON file after all models have loaded and removes it on a clean shutdown. The file holds the process id, the model names and the instance.
rows.notes: No command-line flag exists. When the directory is not writable, rinzler prints `Error: runfile directory is not writable` and exits with code 1 before it loads a model. Log after the write: `Rinzler ready. Wrote PID file: <path>`.

evidence.quote: std::cerr << "Error: runfile directory is not writable: " << dir << " ("

rows.name: RZ_SAVE_TOKENS_PROMPT_ONLY
rows.values: Exactly `0` or `1`. Any other text, including an empty value, stops rinzler at startup with exit code 1.
rows.default: Unset: off. A request with `save_tokens` runs a normal generation. Empty: rinzler exits at startup with code 1.
rows.effect: With `1`, rinzler answers a request that has `save_tokens` set to `true` and generates nothing for it. `save_tokens` is a request field that returns the rendered prompt and its token ids. The response holds only the `save_tokens` object, and its `output_tokens` list is empty. Other requests generate as before.
rows.notes: `1` together with `RZ_ENABLE_SAVE_TOKENS=0` also stops startup. The error log starts with `RZ_SAVE_TOKENS_PROMPT_ONLY validation failed`. With `1`, startup logs `save_tokens requests answer before generation (RZ_SAVE_TOKENS_PROMPT_ONLY=1)`. A value in `/opt/positron/user/config.env` reaches every instance that the packaged systemd unit starts.

rows.name: RZ_SYSTEM_START_DATE
rows.values: A date as `YYYY-MM-DD`. The date must be a real calendar date inside the range of the system clock. The year must be 1000 or later. Other text stops startup.
rows.default: Unset: no fixed date. Each request uses the local date of that day. Empty: rinzler logs a validation error and exits with code 1.
rows.effect: Sets one fixed date that rinzler writes into prompts. The Harmony system message (Harmony is the prompt format of gpt-oss models) uses it as the conversation start date. The `strftime_now` function of Hugging Face chat templates uses local noon of that date.
rows.notes: A bad value logs `RZ_SYSTEM_START_DATE validation failed`. A template that never calls `strftime_now` is not affected. A chat `save_tokens` response shows the date in `rendered_at`. `rinzler_proxy` throws on every generation when the `rendered_at` date of its golden file (its recorded tokens) differs from the variable.

evidence.quote: std::string("RZ_SYSTEM_START_DATE must be YYYY-MM-DD, got '") + env + "'");

rows.name: SPDLOG_LEVEL
rows.values: A level name: `trace`, `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`, `critical` or `off`. Case is ignored. The spdlog library parses the text and ignores an unknown name without a message.
rows.default: Unset: the logger keeps the level from `TRON_LOG_LEVEL`. That level is `debug` when `TRON_LOG_LEVEL` is unset.
rows.effect: Changes the level of the TRON logger after `TRON_LOG_LEVEL` is applied. The stderr output and the log file keep the level from `TRON_LOG_LEVEL`. So the variable can hide messages, and it cannot show more messages.
rows.notes: Example: `warn` hides `info` and `debug` lines. `off` stops all log output. Use `TRON_LOG_LEVEL` to get more detail. The form `NAME=LEVEL` sets one logger, and TRON has one logger, `default_logger`. No log line reports the level. The format comes from spdlog v1.17.0.

rows.name: SUDO_USER
rows.read_by: The hugepage heap setup that libpos startup calls (`src/system/memory.cpp`), in `rinzler`, `runtron` and the hardware test programs. Nothing in TRON sets it. The program `sudo` sets it.
rows.values: Any value, including an empty one. The code tests only that the variable exists.
rows.default: Unset: this check does not stop the program.
rows.effect: When a program runs as root and the variable exists, the hugepage heap setup fails with the log line `Please do not run as sudo`. FPGA card startup then logs `INIT: Environment setup failed. Aborting.` and exits with code 1.
rows.notes: `rinzler` and `runtron` never reach this check as root. They abort earlier with `fuse_sysfs must not run as root`, with or without the variable. The check stops a hardware test program that runs under `sudo`. A root process without the variable passes the check.

evidence.quote: "Please do not run as sudo as this will create root-owned files in "

rows.name: SYSTEM_CONFIG
rows.read_by: `rinzler`, `runtron`, libpos (`src/pos/driver.cpp`, `src/system/system.cpp`). The wrappers `bin/rinzler` and `bin/runtron`, Slice (`bin/slice`), Dice (`bin/dice`), `rinzler_proxy` and test launchers read only `--instance`.
rows.values: Text of system options, split at white space. Double quotes group a value. Options: `--instance X,Y`, `--devices`, `--app-cores`, `--dev-cores`, `--helper-cores`, `--numa`, `--nr_hugepages`, `--hugepage_file`, `--resource-map`, `--tracer-core`, `--kv-cache-gb`, `--optimize`, `--no-opt`, `--heap-shadow`.
rows.default: Unset: only the system options of the command line apply. In a process that Dice starts (`DICE_DAEMON_CHILD=1`), startup fails when the variable holds no `--instance`.
rows.effect: Gives system options to the program through the environment. libpos parses the whole text after the command line. An option given in both places takes the `SYSTEM_CONFIG` value. Outside a Dice-started process, the parse also reloads the resource map. A `--resource-map` given only on the command line is then dropped.
rows.notes: Log: `INIT: environment system config: <text>`. A wrong `--instance` or `--devices` value logs `INIT: invalid SYSTEM_CONFIG` and exits with code 1. Non-numeric text for a numeric option aborts the program. Unknown words are ignored with no message. Only `--instance` always accepts the form `--option=value`.

rows.name: TRACE_FILE

rows.name: TRON_AMX_DISABLE
rows.read_by: libtron, inside `rinzler` and `runtron` (`src/tron/kernels/amx_attn.cpp`). Only a build with the CMake option `TRON_AMX_DISPATCH` reads it.
rows.values: Only the exact text `1` has an effect. Every other text is ignored without a message, for example `0`, `true` or an empty value.
rows.default: Unset: software attention uses the AMX kernel when the CPU, the operating system and the process permission allow AMX.
rows.effect: With `1`, software attention does not use the AMX kernel (code that uses Intel AMX, a matrix instruction set of the CPU). It uses the AVX-512 code for every KV page. The program reads the value one time, at the first use.
rows.notes: `TRON_AMX_DISPATCH` is off by default and on in the `deb` preset (the package build). The AMX kernel serves only models with a head size of 128 dimensions and 4 query heads per KV head. The FUSE stats file `/model/<model id>/attention/summary` shows `amx_available`.

evidence.quote: // TRON_AMX_DISPATCH (CMake option, default OFF) adds an opt-in AMX fast path

new_terms.definition: The systemd unit `packaging/systemd/rinzler@.service` that the tron package installs. It starts one rinzler for each instance.
The hugepage allocator `pos_heap_v2`. The build turns it on by default, and `TRON_USE_ARENA_ALLOCATOR` selects it at run time.
The rinzler build that runs models on the CPU and needs no FPGA card. The `tron-host` package installs it on test and development hosts.
A request field of rinzler. When it is true, the response also holds the rendered prompt, its token ids and the output token ids.
The JSON file `rinzler-<pid>.run`. rinzler writes it after all models have loaded and removes it on a clean shutdown.
The prompt format of gpt-oss models. rinzler renders it with the `openai-harmony` crate.
The registered model name that selects the model code. It is the value of `--model`, or the second field of a `--model-path` value.
The file of recorded tokens that `rinzler_proxy` replays.
Software attention code that uses Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions), a matrix instruction set of the CPU.
A Perfetto trace of 10 seconds that rinzler or runtron starts when it receives the signal `SIGUSR1`.
The command-line options of rinzler and runtron that select the instance, FPGA cards, CPU cores, NUMA node and hugepages.
The YAML file `resource-map.yaml`. It lists the FPGA cards and CPU cores of each server type and how they are divided among instances.
The logging library that TRON uses.

notes: All 12 names are environment variables in scope. No row is dropped, and no row was missing. Every evidence quote was compared with its source line. Rows changed in meaning: SUDO_USER, TIKTOKEN_ENCODINGS_BASE, SYSTEM_CONFIG, RZ_KV_CACHE_GB, RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PATH, RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PRESCOPED, RZ_SYSTEM_START_DATE, TRACE_FILE. Rows changed in wording only: RZ_SAVE_TOKENS_PROMPT_ONLY, TRON_AMX_DISABLE. Row unchanged: SPDLOG_LEVEL. RZ_RUNFILE_DIR changed only in one evidence site. Two evidence quotes of the writer held a bitwise OR sign, which no field may hold, and they were replaced (RZ_RUNFILE_DIR, TRACE_FILE). SUDO_USER is the largest correction. rinzler and runtron create the FUSE stats object before they start libpos, and the fuse_sysfs constructor aborts every root process (src/system/fuse_sysfs.cpp:117). So the SUDO_USER check at src/system/memory.cpp:128 decides nothing for them. It stops hardware test programs under sudo. The audience is now developers. TIKTOKEN_ENCODINGS_BASE: a failed vocabulary load is an uncaught exception. The terminate handler logs a backtrace only (src/common/backtrace.cpp:33-36), so the text 'Failed to load Harmony encoding' is not logged. The same abort follows when the variable is unset on a host with no cached file and no internet access. Two rows hold facts from third-party source that is not in the checkout. SPDLOG_LEVEL: the checkout only calls spdlog::cfg::load_env_levels and pins spdlog v1.17.0. The level names, the empty-value rule and the rule that only the logger level changes were read again in a local copy of spdlog 1.17.0 (include/spdlog/cfg/env.h, cfg/helpers-inl.h, details/registry-inl.h, logger-inl.h). TIKTOKEN_ENCODINGS_BASE: the checkout pins openai-harmony v0.0.8 (commit ec7606df in rust/harmony/Cargo.lock). The read of the variable, the hash check, the cache fallback and the empty-value behaviour were read again in a local copy of that commit (src/tiktoken_ext/public_encodings.rs). They were not run. Facts left out to keep the word limits. RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PATH: a mount that fails throws 'Failed to mount FUSE filesystem at <path>' (src/system/fuse_sysfs.cpp:365). runtron catches it and exits with code 1 (src/runtron.cpp:506-509). rinzler calls stats::start outside a try block (src/rinzler.cpp:4988), so it aborts. RZ_KV_CACHE_GB: the value -1 wraps to the internal 'not set' marker, and rinzler_mock also parses the value. SYSTEM_CONFIG: the log label and the FUSE stats suffix take --instance from the command line first and from SYSTEM_CONFIG only when the command line has none. Three test-side parsers (t_rinzler, t_rinzler_proxy, t/proxy/rzproxy/launch.py) do not accept --instance=X,Y, and bin/slice also accepts a bare X,Y. POS_1GB_PER_NUMA and POS_NR_HUGEPAGES replace --nr_hugepages afterwards, and POS_HUGEPAGE_PATH replaces --hugepage_file (src/pos/driver.cpp:249-288). On a host with one NUMA node, --numa and its value are skipped without a parse. TRACE_FILE: runtron --trace FILE and --trace-gen FILE write the same destination earlier, and TRACE_FILE then changes only later SIGUSR1 captures in runtron. TRON_AMX_DISABLE: the AMX kernel also needs an executor that stores bf16 and a full KV page of 64 tokens. New terms added: rinzler_host, execution slug, resource map. The term 'packaged unit' is now 'packaged systemd unit'.

changes.name: SYSTEM_CONFIG
